purpose: Test whether a gravitational influence with speed, dispersion, and attenuation distinct from photons and local matter can produce identifiable causal observables, while exposing the exact stationary-source limit and the applicability of existing GW, Solar-System, and binary constraints.

law.field_equation: d_t^2 Phi + 2 Gamma d_t Phi - c_g^2 Laplacian(Phi) + c_g^2 mu^2 Phi + c_g^2 zeta/k_star^2 Laplacian^2(Phi) = -4 pi G c_g^2 rho
law.radiative_wavenumber: q=k^2 is the root continuous at zeta->0 of zeta q^2/k_star^2+q+mu^2-(omega^2+2 i Gamma omega)/c_g^2=0; choose sqrt(q) with Im(k)>=0
law.matter_control: Matter uses the same coordinate clock t and responds locally through d_t^2 x=-grad(Phi); no c_g, Gamma, mu, or zeta is inserted into photon or matter kinematics.

parameters.Gamma: nonnegative local damping rate; an open-system bath is mandatory when nonzero
parameters.mu: nonnegative inverse range, equal to m_g c/hbar only for a tensor massive-graviton interpretation

assumptions.clock: A single asymptotic observer clock labels source, gravity, photon, and matter observables. This is required before a speed or delay comparison is meaningful.
assumptions.source: rho is a prescribed source; source generation and radiation reaction are not derived.
assumptions.linearity: The packet is a linear scalar transfer-kernel benchmark, not a covariant tensor completion of gravity.
assumptions.conservation: For Gamma=0 and positive c_g^2, mu^2, zeta, k_star^2 the free-field quadratic energy is positive and conserved. For Gamma>0 field energy decreases; total conservation requires an explicit bath not present in this packet.
assumptions.causality: At zeta=0 the local hyperbolic front speed is c_g. At zeta>0 the continuum k^4 branch has no finite front-speed claim and is admitted only below an EFT cutoff.
assumptions.gr_limit: c_g=c, Gamma=mu=zeta=0 recovers a luminal massless retarded scalar kernel and its Poisson near-zone limit, but not the tensor polarizations or nonlinear dynamics of full GR.

derived_observables.definition: Delta t_g_gamma(omega,D)=D*d Re(k_g)/d omega-D/c plus an unknown intrinsic emission offset
derived_observables.invariant_use: Frequency differences cancel any frequency-independent source offset.

derived_observables.definition: Delta Psi(omega,D)=D*Re(k_g(omega))-omega*D/c after removing constant and linear phase
derived_observables.invariant_use: Nonlinear frequency curvature cannot be absorbed into one emission time and one phase.

derived_observables.definition: A_g/A_control=exp[-D*Im(k_g(omega))] after source-amplitude and geometric-distance calibration
derived_observables.invariant_use: Frequency dependence is more identifiable than a single absolute amplitude.

derived_observables.definition: arg[-4 pi G c_g^2/D(k,omega)] between a measured changing source mode and its local acceleration response
derived_observables.invariant_use: Requires a source-history tracer and force-response tracer on the same clock.

theorems_and_falsifiers.static_invariance: At omega=0, Gamma drops out. With mu=zeta=0, Phi/rho=-4 pi G/k^2 exactly, independent of c_g. Propagation speed alone therefore cannot enhance a stationary galaxy or cluster force.
theorems_and_falsifiers.positive_energy: The conservative free energy density is [(d_t Phi)^2/c_g^2+|grad Phi|^2+mu^2 Phi^2+zeta(Laplacian Phi)^2/k_star^2]/(8 pi G).
theorems_and_falsifiers.pole_stability: At fixed k and zeta>=0, mu>=0, c_g>0, Gamma>=0, the Laplace poles have nonpositive real parts; a zero mode occurs only for k=mu=0.
theorems_and_falsifiers.attenuation_conservation: Gamma>0 without a declared bath fails the closed-system conservation gate; it is labeled rather than deleted.
theorems_and_falsifiers.quartic_front: zeta>0 fails a finite-front-speed claim in the continuum because omega/k grows without bound at large k; it remains an EFT-cutoff branch.
theorems_and_falsifiers.arrival_speed: Any universal radiative branch outside the frozen GW170817 fractional speed interval is falsified under the stated simultaneous-emission assumptions.
theorems_and_falsifiers.mass: Any tensor massive-graviton interpretation above the frozen 2026 90% upper limit is falsified; the same number cannot be applied automatically to a screened nonradiative scalar sector.
theorems_and_falsifiers.solar: The exact stationary Solar-System field passes the Newtonian limit, but moving-body aberration and PPN predictions are not available without a covariant metric/vector completion.
theorems_and_falsifiers.binary: Binary damping cannot be claimed from the propagation kernel alone because emission normalization and radiation reaction are absent; the observed GR agreement is a mandatory future completion gate.
